title: Problem
问题
html:
Primary source: https://arena.ai/leaderboard. Venue/status: Arena AI / LMArena leaderboard infrastructure, 2025. The problem is to evaluate Pairwise human preference vote, tie, or abstention plus model and filter metadata. under a benchmark surface whose feedback is human pairwise preference aggregation. The decision boundary is evaluation and audit: it is not a training recipe, not a general proof of model reliability, and not a reusable reward unless the official source separately releases that contract.

The data object is composed of prompt, model A response, model B response, human vote, ranking snapshot, confidence interval. The benchmark matters because it measures a concrete surface that ordinary static QA or single-function coding tests do not fully cover. For screening, read the card with the source version, scorer, split policy, and released artifacts attached to any claimed score.

一手来源：https://arena.ai/leaderboard，相关排序代码为 https://github.com/lmarena/arena-rank。它要解决的问题，是把开放式对话模型的相对偏好转化为持续更新的排行榜，而不是用固定标准答案判断正确率。

数据对象包括用户提示、两个匿名模型回答、人类偏好或平局投票、模型元数据、排行榜快照和置信区间。反馈来自人类成对偏好及官方聚合方法。边界要收窄到偏好评测：Arena 排名不是事实正确性、数学能力或专业任务能力的直接证明。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
One-sentence contribution: LMArena is a continuing human-preference leaderboard infrastructure that ranks models from anonymized pairwise battles rather than fixed-answer correctness. The core mechanism is to turn a realistic task substrate into an observable input-output-scoring contract rather than only reporting model impressions.

Inputs come from User-submitted prompts in the Arena platform.; outputs are Pairwise human preference vote, tie, or abstention plus model and filter metadata.; feedback is Human pairwise preference aggregated by the official ranking methodology. It belongs under benchmark/evaluation surfaces because the central artifact is the measurement contract. Closest comparisons are other benchmark surfaces in the same domain, but this card should be read at the level of the released task object and scorer rather than as a broad model capability claim.

一句话贡献：LMArena / Arena AI Leaderboard 用匿名双模型对战和用户投票维护开放式模型排名。核心机制是对同一提示展示两个模型回答，收集偏好票，再用公开排序方法形成榜单。

输入是用户提示和两个模型回答；输出是偏好、平局或弃权等投票；反馈是聚合后的排名和不确定性。它应归在评测面方向，因为主要贡献是持续运行的偏好测量基础设施，而不是单篇静态数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
The evaluation pipeline is: present the task input, run the model or agent in the specified substrate, collect the submitted artifact, execute or apply the scorer, and aggregate the result under the official leaderboard/reporting policy. The substrate is Online model comparison platform and leaderboard pipeline.

The verifier/reward component is Human pairwise preference aggregated by the official ranking methodology. Outputs are interpreted only through that contract; training or optimization use is not assumed. Reproducibility depends on pinning the task version, harness or judge version, model settings, release license, and hidden/public split policy. Artifacts to verify are paper=https://arena.ai/leaderboard, project=https://arena.ai/leaderboard, code=https://github.com/lmarena/arena-rank, data=https://huggingface.co/lmarena-ai.

评测流程是：用户提交提示，平台匿名展示两个模型回答，用户选择更好回答或平局，系统记录投票和元数据，再用官方排序方法更新排行榜。底层环境是在线模型比较平台和排序流水线。

评分组件是人类成对偏好的聚合结果。输出只能在固定快照、过滤规则、模型设置和排序版本下解释。复现或比较时需要固定榜单日期、排序代码版本、提示过滤、模型采样设置和置信区间。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is the official source at https://arena.ai/leaderboard. It identifies the benchmark surface, task form, and feedback contract used for reporting. Where code or data are public, the relevant artifact URLs are code=https://github.com/lmarena/arena-rank and data=https://huggingface.co/lmarena-ai.

The evidence boundary is intentionally narrow. Public pages can establish task intent and scoring language, but they may not expose every prompt, hidden test, judge prompt, or leaderboard filter. Any numerical comparison should therefore cite the exact page snapshot, benchmark version, and evaluator settings.

最强证据来自官方来源 https://arena.ai/leaderboard。该来源能确认评测面的任务形态、对象和反馈契约。若代码或数据公开，对应工件是 code=https://github.com/lmarena/arena-rank，data=https://huggingface.co/lmarena-ai。

证据边界要写清楚：公开页面可以确认评测意图和评分语言，但未必公开全部 prompt、隐藏测试、评审提示词或排行榜过滤规则。任何数值比较都应注明页面快照、benchmark 版本和评估设置。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior baselines are generic benchmark leaderboards, single-answer task sets, or narrower domain tests. What changes here is the measurement surface: it asks whether a model can complete Pairwise human preference vote, tie, or abstention plus model and filter metadata. under human pairwise preference aggregation.

The direction signal is useful because it moves evaluation toward the artifact or workflow that users actually inspect. The quality signal is strongest when the scorer, split, and artifact version are explicit. What is not new is the general idea of benchmarking models; the reusable contribution is the particular task object plus feedback contract. Reuse checks should ask: pin snapshot date, ranking package/version, prompt filters, model sampling settings, and confidence intervals; do not treat Arena rank as proof of factual or task-specific correctness.

已有基线多是固定题集或一次性人工评测。这里的新意在于把开放式用户提示和持续投票做成长期排行榜基础设施。

方向信号来自真实用户偏好和模型间相对比较。质量信号取决于投票量、提示分布、去重过滤、排序方法和置信区间。并不新的部分是收集人类偏好；可复用的部分是持续平台、匿名对战和排名聚合契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Limitations center on scorer coverage, release boundary, and snapshot drift. A hidden test, human vote, or judge rubric can be appropriate for the benchmark while still missing important semantic failures. Public visibility can also create contamination risk.

Scores should not be read outside the official harness. Different model scaffolds, sampling settings, browser or tool versions, prompt filters, and hidden-set policies can change outcomes. Official leaderboard, Arena-Rank repository, and LMArena data organization identify the current infrastructure; comparisons must be snapshot-specific.

主要限制来自用户群体偏差、提示分布变化、模型采样设置、位置偏差、冗长偏好和排行榜快照漂移。开放式偏好票不能替代领域正确性验证。

分数不能脱离具体榜单快照解释。不同过滤规则、排序方法、模型版本和平台流量都会影响排名。官方排行榜、Arena-Rank 仓库和 LMArena 数据组织能确认当前基础设施；任何比较都必须注明快照和排序版本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this card to decide whether LMArena / Arena AI Leaderboard is the right evaluation surface for a model, agent, or system claim. It is especially useful when the claim concerns the same artifact type and feedback contract described above.

For collection and comparison, record the official source URL, benchmark version, model setup, and scorer. Avoid using the benchmark name alone as evidence; the useful unit is the pinned task/scorer/snapshot tuple.

这张卡适合用来判断 LMArena / Arena AI Leaderboard 是否匹配某个模型、智能体或系统声明。只有当声明涉及同类任务工件和同类反馈契约时，它才是强证据。

用于比较时，应记录官方来源、benchmark 版本、模型设置和评分器。不要只引用 benchmark 名称；真正有意义的单位是固定后的任务、评分器和快照。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the official source first, then inspect public artifacts if available. Confirm title/version, release date, task count, scorer, split policy, license, and whether model scores are from a live leaderboard or a static report.

Watch for overclaims: benchmark success is not the same as trustworthy deployment, full correctness, or training signal quality. If an artifact is private, record that boundary explicitly rather than filling it with inference.

阅读顺序是先看官方页面，再看公开代码或数据。需要确认标题和版本、发布日期、任务数量、评分器、划分策略、许可协议，以及分数来自动态排行榜还是静态报告。

警惕过度解释：benchmark 成功不等于可部署可信、完全正确或适合作为训练信号。如果某些工件不公开，应把这个边界写明，而不是用推测补齐。
